versions.changelog:
- Expanded and clarified the SKILL.md description to detail features, endpoint coverage, and method naming conventions.
- Added a new section on finding endpoint and type documentation using Go doc and pkg.go.dev.
- Updated usage instructions to emphasize consulting generated method and parameter signatures.
- Removed skill-card.md from the repository.

Initial release of go-zulip skill.

- Adds support for integrating the unofficial Go client for the Zulip REST API.
- Allows invocation via Go projects needing Zulip API access (messages, users, channels, subscriptions, events, administration).
- Requires environment variables for secure configuration: ZULIP_SERVER, ZULIP_EMAIL, ZULIP_API_KEY.
- Guides safe credential use—credentials are never hardcoded or logged.
- Usage restricted to projects already importing github.com/psyb0t/go-zulip.
